exposure: Intrauterine chitosan-covered gauze for postpartum hemorrhage (PPH)
Intrauterine balloon tamponade for postpartum hemorrhage (PPH)
outcome: Reproductive health outcomes (fertility, subsequent pregnancies, deliveries, miscarriages, terminations)
Mental health outcomes (well-being, psychological sequelae, post-traumatic stress disorder)
cohort: Women who delivered at a university hospital between 2016 and 2021, experienced severe postpartum hemorrhage (PPH), and required intrauterine therapy.
finding: Both chitosan gauze and balloon tamponade for PPH appear to have few adverse effects on subsequent menstrual and reproductive function, but women after PPH are at an increased risk of long-term adverse psychological outcomes.
followup_time: Long-term (unspecified duration, with recruitment between 2016-2021 and outcomes reported in 2024)
